title: Library set
description: Parts of the source mapped to libraries already installed in the target project (initialize.params.libraries). Passed from Python through the orchestrator, which never reads it. Each use of a claimed part is a library_call decision; library uses are not equivalence-checked and are always flagged.

caches.description: Where installed packages are looked up (never downloaded): the Maven local repository and Gradle's files-2.1 module cache

target_project.description: Absolute path of the project the output goes into; its pom.xml / gradle.lockfile is checked for each library used

expose.description: Classes offered (a.b.C or a.b.*); all public classes when absent

hints.description: A claimed part's name to the method ids it is steered to (Owner.name(Types))

max_chain.description: Most calls one use may chain (default 4)

pattern.description: path: a directory, file or glob relative to the source root

program.description: paragraph: the PROGRAM-ID it belongs to
